name: Microsoft Copilot (Power BI / Fabric)
bestFor: Natural-language business intelligence for enterprises already on Microsoft 365 and Fabric
description: Copilot inside Power BI lets leaders ask questions of company data in plain English and auto-generates reports and summaries, running on rented Microsoft Fabric compute capacity rather than a per-user AI fee.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; requires a paid Power BI Pro/PPU seat plus Fabric capacity

paidTier.notes: Copilot isn't licensed per user — it runs on Fabric capacity billed monthly (F2 and up, roughly $263–$16,800+/month depending on size) with usage metered in tokens, on top of Power BI Pro (~$14/user/month) or Premium Per User (~$24/user/month) seats. Confirm current Fabric SKU pricing directly with Microsoft.

name: ThoughtSpot (Spotter)
bestFor: Self-serve, natural-language analytics for business users who don't want to write SQL
description: An AI-powered analytics platform where Spotter answers natural-language questions over live company data, letting executives and analysts explore metrics conversationally.

freeTier.limits: No free tier for production analytics; a scoped free Developer plan exists only for embedded-analytics proof-of-concepts (up to 10 users, free for 1 year)

paidTier.notes: Essentials $25/user/month (basic AI search, 25M rows); Pro $50/user/month (Spotter AI, 25 AI queries/user/month included, 250M rows, overage billed per query); Enterprise is custom with unlimited data and users.

name: Tableau (Tableau Agent)
bestFor: AI-assisted visual analytics for organizations standardized on Tableau/Salesforce
description: Tableau's visualization platform with Tableau Agent (natural-language chart creation, powered by Einstein) and Agentforce analytics skills, bundled into the Tableau+ tier.

paidTier.notes: Tableau Standard is $75/user/month, Tableau Enterprise $115/user/month for the base analytics product. The AI features (Tableau Agent, Pulse Premium, Agentforce skills) live in the separately priced Tableau+ bundle, which is custom/sales-quoted only.

name: Domo
bestFor: Usage-based BI with AI-generated insights, for teams that want to pay for consumption rather than seats
description: A cloud BI and data platform that moved from fixed per-user tiers to a consumption-based credit model, with Domo AI Pro adding predictive analytics, automated insights, and natural-language summaries that draw from the same credit pool as everything else.

freeTier.limits: 30-day full-platform trial, unlimited users, no credit card required — not a persistent free tier

paidTier.notes: No published price list; consumption-based via Domo Credits, with AI Pro features (predictions, automated insights) metering separately from the same credit pool. Reported figures: base user fee around $750/user/year, minimum viable deployments (10-25 users) around $30,000/year, scaling into six figures with data volume and integrations — not official figures.

name: Qlik Cloud Analytics
bestFor: Capacity-based BI with AI/predictive analytics reserved for its higher tiers
description: Qlik's cloud analytics platform (Qlik Sense) with associative, in-memory analysis and, from the Premium tier up, AI-driven predictive analytics via automated machine learning — priced by data capacity rather than per user.

paidTier.notes: Starter $300/mo (10 users, 10GB Data for Analysis) — includes conversational AI (Answers Agents) and anomaly detection. Standard $825/mo (25GB, no added per-user cost) — expanded Answers Agents access, still no ML. Premium $2,750/mo (50GB) is the first tier with machine-learning predictive analytics (Qlik Predict) plus added GenAI capacity. Enterprise is custom, starting at 250GB data capacity, reportedly $11,000-$27,500/mo depending on capacity.
